title: 图书馆预约、取消与续借适配
status_note: Implementation, module tests and the audit remediation (P0=0, P1=7, P2=16) are complete and verified offline. Batch integration and the version PR review remain with the integrator.
record_commit: the commit containing this record file
worktree_note: Repo-relative by project privacy rule; the absolute path is kept outside Git and is not written into a committed record.
batch_state: batch 5 is open; this module does not create a PR, merge main or publish a release

cancel_reservation.note: Seat/room cancel verification and receipt handling already existed in batch 4; 5.1 adds tests only. The find_room change affects the booking path, not for_booking=False.

renew_loan.reason: No verified renewal request endpoint. The registered action stays disabled; SYNTHETIC contracts need an explicit constructor opt-in and the default plan is an official-page handoff.

outputs: seat and room plans persist the 4.3 read precheck as an eight-axis precheck_summary without checked_at, so a replay cannot change the digest and any decision-axis change invalidates the plan

seat plans read the per-seat availability state from the precheck item: FULL is rejected, FREE proceeds, while unknown/unmapped states, map-control changes, non-unique same-name seats and missing seat rules become official handoffs
a room with a missing duration rule stays RULE_UNVERIFIED and hands off CONFIRM_ROOM_DURATION_RULE instead of being treated as unlimited or closed
renew_loan binds one own loan id, its current due_at, renew flag/hints and the Primo reader account; preparation reads eligibility only and never sends a renewal request
renew_loan binds contract_id, contract_digest and contract_evidence in the business digest; executing the same plan with another contract fails closed before any request
a SYNTHETIC renewal contract is not executable unless the adapter is constructed with allow_synthetic=True; the production registry stays empty and the transport refuses the same contract
renewal success requires the same loan id to return from a complete own-loan read with a strictly later due instant; date-only or same-day precision changes and equal instants are not success
the bound due_at is never rewritten; the new value only appears as platform.new_due_at and platform.completed_by distinguishes an official handoff from a dispatched plan
a lost or failed renewal response stays UNKNOWN with automatic_resend=false; repeated execute only reconciles
a local prepare failure or a request aborted by the guard is NotDispatched (FAILED/REQUEST_NOT_SENT); a fetch the guard never observed stays UNKNOWN and is never retried
the renewal request is built only from an explicit SourceContract and bound to origin, main frame, transmitted-body hash, success field and one gate capability
the post-renewal todo_query spans the old and new due dates so the renewed loan is found by library.loans

tests added for the pre-existing cancel behaviour (foreign/cross-system records, empty list without a receipt, current room rules without a selected booking window); this verifies batch-4 code rather than claiming new cancel implementation

reconciled platform evidence carries completed_by=OFFICIAL_HANDOFF or ADAPTER_DISPATCH_OR_OFFICIAL_PAGE; verification_level stays REMOTE_RECORD_VERIFIED because the remote record is real, not because our write was accepted
the plan persists reader_account (Primo accountid) and preflight/dispatch/reconcile require the same account; a change fails closed

verified_cases: a seat map control change after prepare rejects the old plan with FAILED/PRECONDITIONS_CHANGED_PREPARE_AGAIN and sends zero requests
an unknown/unmapped seat state becomes OFFICIAL_SEAT_SELECTION and ends in AWAITING_OFFICIAL with zero requests
a room with a missing duration rule hands off CONFIRM_ROOM_DURATION_RULE and never dispatches
a seat or room record outside the current account and a seat id used as a room cancel are rejected before dispatch
an empty seat cancel list without a platform receipt stays UNKNOWN on execute and on later result() calls
renewal eligibility is read only; NOT_ELIGIBLE/OVERDUE/not-found are rejected, unknown eligibility hands off
a plan prepared with contract A cannot dispatch with contract B, even when the loan fields are unchanged
a SYNTHETIC contract cannot dispatch without allow_synthetic=True; the transport refuses it independently
a failed or lost renewal response keeps the original due_at, stays UNKNOWN and repeats only reconciliation
only a strictly later due instant on the same loan is SUCCEEDED; date-only precision changes and equal instants are not
a repeated, short, page-disagreeing or over-limit loan read never prepares a renewal
the successful renewal todo_query covers the old and the new due dates
four concurrent executes of one renewal plan send at most one request
the exact renewal wire rejects a changed body, wrong method, wrong frame, a second gate use and an unobserved delivery
with THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 new renewal plans are blocked while an existing UNKNOWN plan reconciles; THU_LIBRARY_WRITE=0 blocks both new plans and execute of an existing plan
limits: Offline synthetic verification only: no real seat, room or renewal read or write was performed.

Renewal execution is BLOCKED_SOURCE_EVIDENCE: the source registry marks library.renewal PARTIAL and no verified request endpoint exists. The registered renew_loan contract is enabled=false; production can only produce an official-page handoff.
6.1 must register RenewalAction on ('library','renew_loan'); until then the operation reports SOURCE_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED without an adapter.
The leaked path was removed from the branch refs by rewriting the two unpublished record commits; hosting-side unreferenced objects may persist until GitHub garbage-collects them.

The Service Worker fix is at the transport level (an unobserved fetch is UNKNOWN). Setting service_workers='block' on the library browser context and adding a history privacy scan remain requests to 4.4/2.1.
Renewal binds the Primo loan record id; the active-loan read does not expose a separate copy/item id.
Pending seat/room plans created before this module persist a business object without precheck_summary, so they re-prepare instead of executing; they fail closed and no write is replayed.

Seat/room cancellation verification and receipt handling are batch-4 behaviour with no 5.1 implementation change (the room-cancel rule-read test passes on the parent commit too); find_room changed only for the booking path.
THU_SPACE_READ still gates every library adapter through actions.py's adapter-version check; renewal inherits it although it uses no seat/space read.
Renewal cannot be undone on the platform; the module never invents a reverse operation or cancels other loans.
The loan reader is still a separate copy of library.read_loans because library.py belongs to 4.3; its page-agreement check now tolerates truncated titles.
Windows DPAPI execution was not re-run for this module; the Linux offline suite and the shared action framework's platform tests are the evidence here. The batch regression re-runs both platforms.
rollback: Set THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 to stop new renewal plans (reconciliation keeps working), or THU_LIBRARY_WRITE=0 to stop all library writes while reads and pending results stay available. Reverting the code removes the renewal package and the precheck summary from new plans; keep action journals and platform evidence, never delete UNKNOWN/PENDING records, and do not treat local cleanup as a remote cancellation or renewal.
